summary: Mapped one candidate chunk from the Technology theme into ticker-to-node relationships. This chunk clusters around two Serenity sub-themes: AI data-center optical/connectivity infrastructure and AI data-center power/cooling/physical infrastructure. Reference anchors are Vertiv and Eaton; the underfollowed lane includes MACOM, Semtech, Fujikura, Celestica, Powell Industries, and Atkore; Badger Meter remains a speculative shadow candidate. Celestica CLS.TO is treated as a duplicate/cross-listing of CLS, not a separate company idea.
